description:
### ✨ New Features

* **Gboard:** add the Dictionaries & Predictions patch to customize resource versions for dictionaries, text predictions, and input correction models, greatly improving the typing experience.
* **Gboard:** add Key Opacity to Frosted Glass, allowing keys to follow the theme or use a custom percentage independently of background opacity.
* **Gboard:** add Extend to Navigation Bar to Frosted Glass, extending the blur effect into the bottom navigation area for a seamless appearance and automatically adjusting navigation button colors.
* **Gboard:** add the Keypress Vibration Intensity Control patch to control keypress vibration strength instead of duration.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Gboard:** fix the lingering colored light bar and missing word suggestions after official Rambler voice input ends.
* **Gboard:** fix duplicate countdown updates and card recycling issues when clipboard items are hidden or kept permanently, and reduce unnecessary settings reads to lower resource usage.
* **Gboard:** fix the Split Keyboard patch so the split state is preserved after closing and reopening the keyboard.
* **Gboard:** fix an issue that prevented the Developer options page from opening.
* **Gboard:** reduce excessive power consumption in Frosted Glass by eliminating redundant calculations during drawing and layout updates.
* **Gboard:** fix background color blocks remaining after tapping suggestions when custom key opacity is enabled.

### ✨ 新功能

* **Gboard:** 新增Dictionaries & Predictions Patch，可自訂字典、文字預測與輸入修正的模型資源版本，將大幅提升輸入體驗。
* **Gboard:** 磨砂玻璃新增「按鍵透明度」設定，可跟隨主題或自訂百分比，並與背景透明度分開調整。
* **Gboard:** 磨砂玻璃新增「延伸到導覽列」設定，將模糊效果延伸至底部導覽區，讓鍵盤與導覽列融為一體，並自動調整導覽按鈕的顏色。
* **Gboard:** 新增 Keypress Vibration Intensity Control Patch，將按鍵震動從持續時間控制改為力度控制。

### 🐛 修復

* **Gboard:** 修復官方 Rambler 語音輸入結束後，彩色光帶殘留及候選字詞消失的問題。
* **Gboard:** 修復剪貼簿隱藏與永久保留時的重複倒數更新及卡片回收問題，並減少不必要的設定讀取，降低額外資源消耗。
* **Gboard:** 修復「分離式鍵盤」(split keyboard) Patch 在關閉並重新開啟鍵盤後，無法保留分離狀態的問題。
* **Gboard:** 修復無法開啟「開發人員選項」（Developer options）頁面的問題。
* **Gboard:** 修復磨砂玻璃耗電偏高的問題，移除繪製與重新排版時的重複運算，降低資源消耗。
* **Gboard:** 修復啟用自訂按鍵透明度時，點選候選詞後背景色塊仍然殘留的問題。

patches.name: AI Writing Tools
patches.description:
啟用 AI 撰寫工具，支援所有語言
Enable AI writing tools with support for all languages.

patches.name: Access Points menu style
patches.description:
切換新版或舊版 Access Points 選單樣式
Switch between the new and legacy Access Points menu styles.

patches.name: Add Gboard Signature Bypass
patches.description:
攔截 Gboard 的簽章白名單檢查並強制通過
Bypass Gboard signature whitelist checks and force them to pass.

patches.name: Advanced Voice Typing
patches.description:
啟用進階語音輸入（包含自動標點功能），並另外為不支援進階語音輸入的繁體中文語音啟用自動標點
Enable Advanced Voice Typing with automatic punctuation, and separately enable automatic punctuation for Traditional Chinese voice typing, which does not support Advanced Voice Typing.

patches.name: Backup & Restore
patches.description:
匯出或還原全部 Patches 設定，並備份、比較及還原 Gboard PB/XML flag store
Export or restore all Patches settings, and back up, compare, or restore the Gboard PB/XML flag store.

patches.name: Change emoji size
patches.description:
變更表情符號大小
Change emoji size.

patches.name: Clipboard Custom Character Limit
patches.description:
自訂每個文字剪貼簿項目的最大字元數
Customize the maximum character count for each text clipboard item.

patches.name: Clipboard Enhancements
patches.description:
增強剪貼簿的保留時間、數量上限、預覽行數、倒數/建立時間、順序編號與欄數
Enhance clipboard retention time, item count limit, preview lines, countdown/creation time labels, order index, and column count.

patches.name: Close Proactive Suggestions
patches.description:
在主動建議列顯示關閉按鈕
Show a dismiss button in the proactive suggestions bar.

patches.name: Custom Symbols
patches.description:
新增獨立的特殊符號分頁，長按逗號->愛心
Add a dedicated custom symbols tab and replace the long-press comma entry with a heart shortcut.

patches.name: Custom Theme
patches.description:
支援匯入自訂 ZIP 主題，並支援從 Rboard 官方儲存庫匯入精美主題。
Import custom ZIP themes and beautiful themes from the official Rboard repository.

patches.name: Developer options
patches.description:
啟用 開發人員選項 與 Flag 編輯器，你可以自己修改Flag的值
Enable Developer options and the Flag Editor, allowing you to modify flag values.

patches.name: Dictionaries & Predictions
patches.description:
可選擇字典、預測及輸入修正的資源版本
Choose resource versions for dictionaries, predictions, and input correction.

patches.name: Emojis, stickers & GIFs Tab Order
patches.description:
自訂 Gboard「Emojis, stickers & GIFs」底部 tabs 的排序，支援拖曳調整
Customize the bottom tab order in Gboard's Emojis, stickers & GIFs panel with drag-and-drop reordering.

patches.name: Enable Inline Autofill Suggestions
patches.description:
啟用內嵌自動填入建議
Enable Inline Autofill Suggestions

patches.name: Enable OCR / Scan Text
patches.description:
啟用 OCR / 掃描文字功能，支援 拉丁、中文、日文、韓文 與 天城文 辨識後端
Enable the OCR / Scan Text feature with Latin, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Devanagari recognition backends.

patches.name: Enable accessibility layout
patches.description:
啟用無障礙鍵盤配置
Enable accessibility layout.

patches.name: Enable cursor trackpad mode
patches.description:
長按空白鍵開啟游標觸控板與鎖定模式
Long-press the space bar to use cursor trackpad and lock modes.

patches.name: Enable split keyboard
patches.description:
啟用分離式鍵盤
Enable the split keyboard layout.

patches.name: English QWERTY Up-Flick Uppercase
patches.description:
英文 QWERTY 鍵盤上滑大小寫
Flick up on the English QWERTY keyboard to toggle uppercase and lowercase.

patches.name: FTP Server
patches.description:
新增區域網路 FTP 伺服器，支援檔案瀏覽、傳輸與下載續傳
Add a LAN FTP server with file browsing, transfers, and download resume.

patches.name: Floating Web Search
patches.description:
直接從 Gboard 開啟懸浮網頁，快速搜尋需要的資訊。
Open a floating web page directly from Gboard to quickly search for the information you need.

patches.name: Frosted Glass
patches.description:
為鍵盤加入即時背景模糊與自訂主題透明度。
Add live background blur and custom-theme opacity to the keyboard.

patches.name: G Logo on Spacebar
patches.description:
在空白鍵顯示 G Logo，並隱藏語言名稱
Show the G Logo on the spacebar and hide the language label.

patches.name: Grammar Checker
patches.description:
啟用 修正和建議 > 文法檢查
Enable Text correction > Grammar check.

patches.name: Incognito Mode Toggle
patches.description:
在 Access Point 工具列新增無痕模式切換按鈕，並可設定無痕模式下是否啟用剪貼簿與語音輸入
Add an Incognito toggle to the Access Point toolbar and configure clipboard and voice typing availability while Incognito mode is active.

patches.name: Inline Suggestions
patches.description:
啟用 修正和建議 > 智慧撰寫
Enable Text correction > Smart Compose.

patches.name: Key Shape Selection
patches.description:
啟用圓角按鍵，主題詳情 > 按鍵形狀
Enable Key shape in Theme details.

patches.name: Keypress Vibration Intensity Control
patches.description:
將按鍵震動由持續時間改為力度控制。
Control keypress vibration intensity instead of duration.

patches.name: Latin Globe Key Ignore Interval
patches.description:
新增英文鍵盤地球鍵忽略時間覆寫，可獨立控制輸入後切語言延遲
Add an independent English globe key ignore interval override for post-typing language-switch delay.

patches.name: Long-Press Editing Shortcuts
patches.description:
在英文 QWERTY 與注音鍵盤加入全選、復原、複製、剪下、貼上與重做長按快捷鍵
Add Select all, Undo, Copy, Cut, Paste, and Redo long-press shortcuts to English QWERTY and Zhuyin.

patches.name: Package Rename
patches.description:
將套件名稱改成 dev.jason.com.google.android.inputmethod.latin，並可自訂 App 名稱，以便共存安裝
Rename the package to dev.jason.com.google.android.inputmethod.latin and allow a custom app name so it can be installed alongside the official Gboard.

patches.name: Quick Insert
patches.description:
啟用快速插入面板與工具列入口
Enable the Quick Insert panel and toolbar access point.

patches.name: Rounded Keyboard Panel
patches.description:
自訂鍵盤面板哪些角落呈現圓角，並分別設定上方與下方半徑。
Customize which corners of the keyboard panel are rounded, and set the top and bottom radii separately.

patches.name: Settings Homepage Override
patches.description:
允許切換新版或舊版 Gboard 設定頁面
Allow switching between the new and legacy Gboard settings pages.

patches.name: Simple Calculator
patches.description:
直接輸入算式，在 Gboard 推薦列顯示可捲動算式與答案。
Type an expression and show a scrollable equation plus its answer in Gboard's suggestion row.

patches.name: Swipe Down to Dismiss Keyboard
patches.description:
從建議列或工具列向下滑動以關閉鍵盤。
Swipe down from the suggestions or toolbar to close the keyboard.

patches.name: Swipeable Custom Top Row
patches.description:
滑動鍵盤第一排，在原生列與可自訂文字/JavaScript 列之間切換
Swipe the keyboard top row to switch between the stock row and a customizable text/JavaScript row.

patches.name: Toolbar Editing Buttons
patches.description:
將全選、複製、剪下與貼上加入選單。
Add Select All, Copy, Cut and Paste to the menu.

patches.name: Top Toolbar Item Count
patches.description:
自訂 Gboard 頂端工具列項目數量
Customize the Gboard top toolbar item count.

patches.name: Use Bluetooth Microphone
patches.description:
啟用 語音輸入 -> 使用藍芽麥克風
Enable Voice typing -> Use Bluetooth microphone.

patches.name: Web Clipboard
patches.description:
新增手機自架的 Web Clipboard，支援瀏覽器同步、配對碼與快速設定開關
Add the phone-hosted Web Clipboard with browser sync, pairing, and a Quick Settings Tile.

patches.name: Zhuyin Bottom Row Key Sizes
patches.description:
調整注音鍵盤底排按鍵大小
Adjust Zhuyin keyboard bottom-row key sizes.

patches.name: Zhuyin Quick Traditional/Simplified Toggle
patches.description:
注音 ㄥ 上滑快速切換繁簡
Swipe up on Zhuyin ㄥ to quickly toggle Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

patches.name: Zhuyin Slide Input
patches.description:
注音鍵盤支持上下滑輸入
Enable slide-up and slide-down input on the Zhuyin keyboard.
